# Quantum Branding
> Quantum Branding is the independent brand strategy practice of Nizzar Ben Chekroune, across Brand x AI x Business. Its client method is The Collapse: Observe, Collapse, Build, Hold.
## What it does
Brand and positioning, marketing and sales, digital and experience, AI and intelligent systems, for companies with something important to improve, launch, rethink or build. Work is direct with Nizzar Ben Chekroune.

## SIGNAL (podcast and daily curation)
SIGNAL is a daily curation. The noise filtered. The signal kept. SIGNAL is the daily podcast and curation on AI, brands, business and culture by Nizzar Ben Chekroune, editor, published by Quantum Branding. It is a publication of Nizzar Ben Chekroune, not a separate media company.
- Archive and transcripts (EN + FR): https://nizzar.com/signal
- Spotify EN: https://open.spotify.com/show/7jRF8SDhxOVUTSmWs2vp8g
- Spotify FR: https://open.spotify.com/show/664MyOZ9Gswe0r3EJzDTyK
- Apple Podcasts EN: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/signal-ai-brands-business-culture/id6818072638
- Apple Podcasts FR: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/signal-ia-marques-business-culture/id6818073414

- What is Quantum Branding (entity page): https://quantumbranding.ai/what-is-quantum-branding
Disambiguation: this Quantum Branding was founded in 2024 by Nizzar Ben Chekroune. It is not the Nashville agency of the same name founded in 2004, which is unrelated.
